description: Work out zakat (zakat al-mal) on a person's gold: nisab 85 grams of pure gold (or the 595 g silver nisab if their scholars use it), rate 2.5%, due once the gold has been owned one hijri year (haul). Indonesia: valued at the latest Antam buyback price; elsewhere: the world gold price in the person's currency. Takes several items with their karat or fineness; worn jewellery is shown both ways unless the person says which view they follow (Hanafi counts it; Shafi'i, Maliki and Hanbali generally do not); an optional haul start date. A general calculation, not a fatwa. Nothing is stored and no receipt is kept.

country.description: Two-letter country code. ID values gold at the Antam buyback price.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code. Default IDR in Indonesia, else USD.

haul_start_date.description: When the person's gold first reached the nisab (YYYY-MM-DD), if known.

items.description: The gold, one entry per item or per group of the same kind.

fineness.description: Fineness in parts per thousand, e.g. 999.9 or 750. Overrides karat. Bars without it count as 999.9.

karat.description: Karat. Required for jewellery unless fineness is given.

worn.description: Jewellery that is regularly worn. Default false.

lang.description: Answer language: id = Bahasa Indonesia, en = English (default).

nisab.description: Which nisab: gold (85 g, default) or silver (595 g).

worn_jewellery.description: The view the person follows on worn jewellery. Default show_both.

name: gold_zakat
title: Zakat on gold
